exposure: Thoracic fluid content (TFC) measured by electrical bioimpedance
outcome: Respiratory distress at birth and at 24 hours of life
cohort: 96 newborn infants with a mean gestational age of 37.9 weeks
finding: Thoracic fluid content (TFC) measured by electrical bioimpedance was independently associated with the presence of respiratory distress at both birth and 24 hours of life in late preterm and term newborn infants.
